note: 422 validation envelopes bound the error path like the message (a long map key is cut, not echoed whole). vespera_core rejects a Reference Object ($ref) on Response, RequestBody and Parameter (with or without siblings) instead of silently dropping the reference. A streaming header-callback failure followed by a Rust panic keeps the header-failed message and still reports panicked() to Java. Test-only fixes in the C ABI and reattest workflow: a re-attest dispatched from a non-main ref now fails instead of skipping green.
